title: ChainGetReply
description: The parsed form of a chain_get reply (a chain): one property per word of the reply, a list an array, a record an object, a whole number or a decimal one a number.

worker.description: The worker the chain runs on, w<k>, or - when it has none.

members.description: The instances of the chain, in order.

items.description: One item: a whole number, not negative.

running.description: The members that are running now, in order.
